description:
One day, a mysterious woman appears before Ethan, an orphan who has grown up with nothing. She offers him a large sum of money in exchange for transcribing the Bible and takes him to a remote, ominous mansion. Haunted by rumors surrounding the estate, Ethan feels uneasy—until he meets its master, Leo. The moment their eyes meet, a strange mix of familiarity and confusion washes over him. He tries to brush it off, but that very night, he encounters Leo again—this time, drenched in desire. In a mansion filled with secrets and unsettling happenings, Ethan finds himself drawn into something far beyond his understanding. Will he be able to finish his task and make it out safely?
Source: MU
